caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, open box with a hinged lid, covered in a rich red fabric that is textured and gathered on the inside of the lid. The box contains several objects: a round, lidded container with a gold edge and an illustrated scene featuring two figures, one in a pink dress and one in a yellow outfit, set outdoors; a cylindrical, gold cup-like object with an ornate design; a rectangular embroidered case or book cover displaying a pair of dancing figures in colorful costumes, surrounded by floral details; and a closed, dark leather-bound case or wallet with a strap or belt across the top. The interior of the box is lined with the same deep red fabric as the exterior. The overall composition places all objects neatly within the open box, with the lid angled upward and slightly back. In the top right corner outside the box, there are two simple line drawings depicting the box's overall shape and clasp, and in the bottom left corner of the page there is a small number “10” inside a white square. The background of the drawing is off-white with no other distinguishing marks.
title: Lady's Dressing Case
